subject: QBR hiring triage — strategic vs backfill decisions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR hiring triage — strategic vs backfill decisions

Team —

Running through QBR prep and we need to finalize headcount decisions by EOD Monday so Finance and Recruiting can lock offers for any approved reqs. Attached is the updated prioritization workbook (QBR_headcount_prio_v2.xlsx) with a short column called "Decision ask" — Approve / Freeze / Exception. High-level notes up front: 

- Total open reqs touched by this thread: 7 (see sheet 'Working set')
- Immediate backfills recommended: REQ-3401 (SRE), REQ-3417 (ML Infra backfill)
- Strategic add request: REQ-3428 (Senior Product Manager, infra roadmap) — this is the one that needs leadership trade-off discussion (headcount vs. deferral)
- Hiring freeze candidate: REQ-3390 (Growth analyst) — low impact, recommend freeze for 1 quarter

Asks: 
1) Markus & Vivek: please mark Approve / Freeze / Exception for each req in the attached sheet. If you flag Exception, add 1–2 sentence justification so I can include it in the QBR memo.
2) Laura: quick alignment from People on backfill timelines (Monica is cc'd).
3) Michael: confirm remaining budget runway for hires categorized as "Strategic" (REQ-3428) — we need a hard yes/no to recommend approval.

I'll consolidate responses into a single decision matrix and circulate a final memo for the QBR packet. Plan to call out any exception items during the leadership prep on Friday. 

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Head of Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_headcount_prio_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 160KB); REQ-3417_cheatsheet.pdf (one-page role brief)

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR hiring triage — strategic vs backfill decisions

Thanks Soojin — skimmed the sheet. Quick thoughts: 

- I support approving the SRE backfill (REQ-3401) and the ML Infra backfill (REQ-3417) as they are critical to our stability work for the quarter.
- For REQ-3428 (Sr PM infra), I need a clearer set of success criteria and a short ROI estimate. If this hire materially speeds the infra roadmap (and thus reduces infra unit costs by >10% within 6 months), I can push it as an Exception.
- Freeze REQ-3390 is fine with me for one quarter.

Michael — can you run a quick check on the headcount budget versus committed spend for Q4 and confirm whether we have a 1.0 FTE buffer for strategic exceptions? If not, we'll need to prioritize which exception (if any) to surface.

Markus
VP, Engineering

Looping in brief context from Product org perspective: 

- The SRM squad (REQ-3421 / product IC) is at 85% capacity; one of the two requested producers is effectively a backfill for a promoted lead. The second producer is a direct add to accelerate a merchant integration; that can be delayed one quarter without major OKR impact. 
- For the Sr PM (REQ-3428), product leadership would like the hire approved if we can show a measurable milestone (three accelerated deliverables tied to infra cost reduction or latency improvement). If we approve, Product will provide the milestone list by Fri.

Monica — hiring timeline for backfills (SRE + ML Infra) — can recruiting commit to posted offer within 10 business days post-approval? We need tight timelines to avoid runway gaps.

— Laura
Director, Product Operations

Acknowledged. Recruiting can move quickly on the two backfills (REQ-3401, REQ-3417). Timeline assumptions: 

- Sourcing + screen to offer: 8–12 business days if the interview panel is available.
- For REQ-3417 (ML Infra), we have a shortlist from TalentBridge that could compress to 6–8 days. Elena (TalentBridge) — please confirm candidate availability and estimated fee schedule for expedited search.

Also, small ask: for any Exception approvals, we need written justification (1 paragraph) to attach to the req packet for audit and finance. Monica will prepare standard template.

Subject: Finalized QBR headcount memo — decisions and next steps

Thanks all for the quick turn. Final consolidated decisions below (I've updated the workbook and attached the final packet to the QBR Drive link):

- REQ-3401 (SRE backfill): APPROVED — Recruiting to post today. Target offer within 10 business days.
- REQ-3417 (ML Infra backfill): APPROVED (expedited) — TalentBridge to prioritize shortlisted candidates; Monica to confirm condensed timeline.
- REQ-3428 (Sr PM infra): EXCEPTION PENDING — Condition: Product to submit 3 milestone KPIs by Friday COB; Finance to confirm 1.0 FTE buffer. If both satisfied, escalate for approval during leadership prep.
- REQ-3390 (Growth analyst): FREEZE — defer for one quarter, revisit in planning cycle.

Action items: 
- Monica: confirm TalentBridge fee and candidate availability (Elena) and post SRE role today.
- Laura: submit milestone KPIs for REQ-3428 by Fri COB.
- Michael: provide final budget confirmation (yes/no on 1.0 FTE buffer) by end of day Monday.
- Markus/Vivek: flag any additional exceptions by Monday 10am so I can include them in the QBR packet.

I'll include the Exception paragraph template Monica mentioned in the shared drive and append the final memo to the QBR pack. Thanks — tight timeframe but should leave us in a good position for the QBR.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference
